practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Test should focus on a single behavior. EVALUATION: method constructs Grafo, calls toString, and includes a simulated exceptional-flow (throw/catch) — multiple Act operations and multiple concerns. DECISION: multiple distinct Act operations >1 => non-compliant.
PRINCIPLE: Tests must be independent. EVALUATION: method uses only local variables and no shared mutable state; no @Before/@After required. DECISION: only local state used => compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Coverage of Normal and Exceptional Flows
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Provide both happy-path and error-path tests. EVALUATION: class contains only this single test (happy-path-like) and the simulated exception is thrown-and-caught without a meaningful assertion or separate test method. DECISION: only one test method for the behavior => non-compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Test boundaries (min/max). EVALUATION: This test constructs an object and checks toString; no input domain or numeric/string boundaries are present. DECISION: no obvious boundaries to test => not-applicable.
PRINCIPLE: Extract helpers and constants. EVALUATION: Test is short (<10 lines) and contains no duplicated logic in this class. DECISION: short self-contained test without duplication => compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Detailed Analysis of Size and Complexity
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Keep tests small and simple. EVALUATION: Method is compact (no loops, no complex conditionals) and under 20 lines. DECISION: simple linear flow => compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Assertions should verify multiple properties. EVALUATION: The test contains two explicit assertions (instance not null and toString not null). DECISION: >=2 assertions verifying properties => compliant.
PRINCIPLE: Avoid disabled or commented tests. EVALUATION: No @Ignore/@Disabled annotations or commented-out @Test methods are present. DECISION: all tests active => compliant.
PRINCIPLE: Link tests to requirements. EVALUATION: Method includes Javadoc 'REQ-001' and Given-When-Then linking to a requirement. DECISION: explicit requirement ID present => compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Rigorous Use of Performance and Security Tests
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Performance/security tests explicit. EVALUATION: The @Test annotation includes a timeout (timeout = 4000), which is an explicit timing-related setting. DECISION: presence of timeout qualifies as explicit performance-related test configuration => compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Descriptive test names. EVALUATION: Method name is 'test0' which is generic and does not follow descriptive naming conventions despite having a descriptive comment. DECISION: generic name => non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Small Footprint of Test Code Generation
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Avoid heavy auto-generated artifacts. EVALUATION: The class uses org.evosuite.runtime imports, EvoRunner, EvoRunnerParameters and has test named 'test0'—all strong signs of heavy code generation. DECISION: generated patterns present => non-compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should show design intent. EVALUATION: The method Javadoc contains Given-When-Then and a requirement id, indicating test-first or BDD-style design. DECISION: Given-When-Then present => compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Prefer public-API testing and avoid implementation coupling. EVALUATION: Test uses public constructor and toString only; no reflection or access to internals. DECISION: public API usage only => compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Use specific assertions and messages. EVALUATION: Assertions use assertNotNull with descriptive messages (both assertions include messages). DECISION: specific assertions with messages => compliant.

PRINCIPLE: Comments should add value. EVALUATION: The test contains a helpful Javadoc with Given-When-Then and short inline comments; no commented-out code. DECISION: minimal useful comments => compliant.
PRINCIPLE: Avoid non-determinism. EVALUATION: No Random, time-based calls, sleeps, or external dependencies are used in the method. DECISION: deterministic constructs only => compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Tests should not leave side effects. EVALUATION: Test creates only in-memory objects and performs no file, DB, or static modifications; no cleanup required. DECISION: no side effects present => compliant.

practices_evaluation.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_evaluation.justification: PRINCIPLE: Use tags/categories for organization. EVALUATION: Class is annotated with @Category(UnitTest.class) and a marker interface is present. DECISION: category annotation present => compliant.

practices_report.description: Each test should focus on a single requirement/behavior (one Arrange-Act-Assert).
Tests must be independent and not share mutable state without setup/teardown.

practices_report.practice_title: Coverage of Normal and Exceptional Flows
practices_report.description: Provide at least one happy path and one error/exception test for behaviors.
Validate inputs at boundaries (min, max, just outside).
Extract helpers/constants to remove duplication and improve reuse.

practices_report.practice_title: Detailed Analysis of Size and Complexity
practices_report.description: Keep tests small (<20 lines) and avoid loops/complex conditionals.
Assertions should verify multiple properties to detect faults deeply.
Avoid @Ignore/@Disabled and commented-out tests; keep suite active.
Link tests to requirements via annotations or Javadoc (REQ- IDs).

practices_report.practice_title: Rigorous Use of Performance and Security Tests
practices_report.description: Include explicit performance/security tests where relevant (timeouts, auth).
Test names should describe scenario and expected outcome (method_condition_result).

practices_report.practice_title: Small Footprint of Test Code Generation
practices_report.description: Avoid verbose auto-generated tests; prefer concise intention-revealing tests.

practices_report.practice_title: Complete Prioritization of Test Case Design
practices_report.description: Tests should show design intent (Given-When-Then or BDD-style naming).

practices_report.practice_title: Responsible Addition of Test Code Maintenance
practices_report.description: Focus on observable behavior via public APIs; avoid testing internals.
Use specific assertions with descriptive messages when appropriate.
Comments should explain 'why' not 'what'; avoid commented-out code.
Avoid randomness, current time, thread sleeps and external dependencies without mocking.

practices_report.practice_title: Complete Avoidance of Test Side Effects
practices_report.description: Tests should not persist data or modify shared/global state without cleanup.

practices_report.practice_title: Suitable Utilization of Test Labels and Categories
practices_report.description: Use @Tag/@Category to classify tests for selective execution.
